notes.title: Stories of Mara, a visual novel slice-of-life will be out on August 26th!
notes.content:
Hi there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/2c6763d5a05102a8f68c824187f9addf6709f68c.jpg[/img]

We're thrill to announce that [b]Stories of Mara[/b], an episodic visual novel that tells the story of the neighbors of Mara,[b] will be out on August 26th[/b]! Chapter One will be [b]free on Steam[/b] and Itch.io. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1647780/Stories_of_Mara/

Set in the same universe as Deiland Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara, [b]Stories of Mara describe the little tidbits of life happening in these islands where your choices will define the course of the story[/b] and affect the relationships with the community.

[previewyoutube=8gjeRRMm1lM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Chapter One starts following Akaji[/b], a procrastinating blacksmith who has to ask for the help of all her neighbors to find Koa, who has disappeared while dealing with her own issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/9b23aefd1383eec7c4d115a8bd36b553f5ecb0f2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/734b1125f9fdc948aa418057e2be3de0eb51f1ed.png[/img]

Key Features

  [list]
[*]  [b] A bit-sized slice of life visual novel[/b] following a diverse cast from the calm and relaxing supernatural world of Summer in Mara. A soap opera featuring from trickster pirates to adventurer cat-children.    

[*]     Depending on how you bond with the cast will affect the relationships with the community and the ending. [b]Your choices matter in the course of the story[/b] throughout different chapters.
 
[*]      [b]Express yourself through making boat modelism [/b]to share with the rest of the community. This will impact how they see you and how you see them.

[*][b]Visuals inspired by the Studio Ghibli [/b]films with a modern setting in a fantasy universe.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/98224c81623396cece46459d49922eff5a4a28c4.gif[/img]

See you in Mara!

notes.title: UPDATE: Fast travel and additional crafting points
notes.content:
Dear players,

A week ago we released Summer in Mara. During this week, you give us your feedback regarding different issues and ideas for us to work on and improve. 

We heard you and we want to use your feedback to improve Summer in Mara. In this update we implemented two features that will improve the experience of the game:

[list]
[*]  [b]Fast travel[/b]: Now Koa can travel immediately to any island that you have discovered previously. This way, you don't have to go from quadrant to quadrant, avoiding loading screens.

[*] [b] Crafting and cooking[/b]. We thought it's a good idea to let Koa craft and cook in other islands, near to the main characters. Now you can craft/cook in Taka's restaurant, Akaji forge and Dunna's island.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/d2db6b5959f554769fb0f0db27e6d6a7095f8500.png[/img]

We hope these improvements help you during the game. Please, keep sharing your feedback and feel free to give us your opinion.

See you in Mara,
Chibig.

notes.title: Updates Roadmap
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thanks for support Summer in Mara, thanks for play it and thanks for your feedback.

We are 5 people in Chibig just now. We are putting all our efforts to improve the game, fix the issues and heard all your comments. However we can't go as fast as we would like, so we appeal to your patience.

We are really commited with Summer in Mara, we think it is a good game that can be better. Those are our priorities by now:

GENERAL
- Fix the bugs!
- Improve some feedback to guide the player: like add more arrows and tip text in some quests.
- Improve Koa's controls.
- Balance the time pass and questlines.

GAMEPLAY
- Add fast - travel to any island you have visited.
- Add craft tables in other points outside Koa - island (like restaurants or workshops).
- Improve the sailing experience.

UI
- Add "delete save" option ingame.
- Add some extra option to configurate the camera (fov, sensitivity)
- Add window mode options.
- Add Koa position to Qälis map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/89f6ec3f85f81c8a1a63ee1b429959f3c151c432.png[/img]

We are working on this during the next weeks. Please feel free to suggest any other changes that you think good improvements for "Summer in Mara".

See you in Mara!
